about: Final answers as the provider sends them, and how both readers take them: native prompt.rs read_answer (prompt_tests.rs) and readAdaptAnswer in adaptContract.ts. A case is a raw final text, or an envelope serialized as JSON after fill sets field to unit repeated count times, then end when given. expect is reply (the stored reply, compared exactly when given), invalid or tooLarge.
